attributes.board_name: North Carolina State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Providers recognized by ADA CERP, AGD, ADHA or their components; NC AHEC; dental/dental hygiene/dental assisting schools; societies and associations; government entities; FQHCs. Must relate to clinical patient care
rules.audit_note: Hours certified on the renewal application; keep records at least 2 years and produce on request.
rules.notes: Annual renewal by Jan 31; void if not compliant by Mar 31. Self-study allowed (test required). 1 h mental health/substance use CE every two calendar years (no matching topic code). Unexpired CPR required in addition to the hours.
rules.rule_quote: (a) As a condition of license renewal, each dental hygienist shall complete six clock hours of continuing education each calendar year.

topics.who: Unexpired CPR, in addition to the hours
